description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library, without a PyTorch dependency. This fighter runs voxtral-mini-3b (speech-llm), covering de, en, es, fr, hi, it, nl, pt. Requires an onnx-asr build with the speech-llm model family (TigreGotico/onnx-asr branch feat/speech-llm-qwen3-asr as of this writing, not yet in a released version).
notes: Model from the OpenVoiceOS 'stt-asr-onnx' HuggingFace collection. Needs onnx-asr with speech-llm support (unreleased as of this writing; see TigreGotico/onnx-asr branch feat/speech-llm-qwen3-asr).
